# Niivue 0.69.0

`niivue.umd.js` copied unchanged from the npm package `@niivue/niivue@0.69.0` (https://registry.npmjs.org/@niivue/niivue/-/niivue-0.69.0.tgz), `dist/niivue.umd.js`: minified, with its dependencies bundled in, and it sets the global `niivue`.

- Niivue: BSD-2-Clause. The npm package does not ship the licence file; `LICENSE` comes from the repository at the tag of this version (github.com/niivue/niivue, tag `@niivue/niivue-v0.69.0`).
- Bundled dependencies, as declared in its `package.json` (licences from the npm registry): @lukeed/uuid (MIT), @ungap/structured-clone (ISC), array-equal (MIT), fflate (MIT), gl-matrix (MIT), nifti-reader-js (MIT), zarrita (MIT).
